studies.title: The lateen sail
studies.caption: A triangular sail set on a long slanting yard, the rig of the dhows of the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean.
studies.prompt: Clear low shoreline view near Aden about500CE of a modest wooden trading craft with a triangular sail on a long sloping yard; sailors trimming rope in a crosswind. The sail and its attachment remain structurally legible; no European galleon, metal winch, or modern fittings.
